answer: Locks are written down in fable, expire in garden, and trellis lists each expiry. Someone running 119 aliases therefore needs 25 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 959 identities would post 4038 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
